tables.title: Example of credit value per transmit cycle
tables.text_helper: Table 770, "Example of credit value per transmit cycle", in section 76.4.4 (Multiple channels and queues support) on page 4001. Columns: Mode, portTransmitRate, idleSlope, sendSlope, Credit value. 1 data row(s).

rows:
– portTransmitRate = 100Mbps
– idleSlope = 70Mbps (assuming 
70% bandwidth reserved for a 
higher priority traffic class)
– sendSlope = 30Mbps

– credit = 2.8 bits, accumulated per cycle 
(40ns) for the higher priority traffic class 
when best-effort packet is being 
transmitted.
– credit = 1.2 bits, drained per cycle (40 ns) 
when higher priority traffic class packet is 
being transmitted.
